title: Select and materialize the next reuse-first capability wave
goal: Validate the fresh reuse-first-v1 selection of CAP-INV-005 against its canonical Hunt Management contract and materialize exactly one bounded implementation wave with realistic child sizing, without choosing unresolved implementation technology.
inputs: VERIFIED E10-SCALE-003A readiness and wave-selection evidence
canonical CAP-INV-005 Hunt Management Product Spec contract
outputs: fresh source-backed confirmation of CAP-INV-005 selection
invariants: product runtime code is not changed by scaling-control tasks
CAP-INV family preference does not imply runtime-boundary reuse
no technical provider, storage, query or UI choice is invented without source or decision evidence
blocked/proposed behavior remains excluded from the wave
security_properties: selected canonical capability path must resolve inside the read-only Product Spec
all permission, tenant, audit, provenance and OPEN-decision constraints found in the canonical contract must be preserved
wave decomposition must split any task exceeding complexity budgets
acceptance_tests: canonical Hunt Management capability file and referenced obligations resolve
all generated child manifests pass strict-v2 and complexity validation
one first child is READY and all later children are dependency-gated

performance_budget.rationale: control-plane decomposition only; runtime budgets are compiled in capability child work before runtime implementation

migration.rationale: no product runtime or persistent data is changed

rollback.strategy: revert the wave materialization without changing verified runtimes or the ledger

definition_of_done: selection is exactly READY and source-backed
canonical Hunt Management capability contract is reflected in a bounded wave
child lots stay within complexity budgets
one next READY implementation task exists
